components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill used for Download Halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #051A24; color: #F6FCFF; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 14px Satoshi, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(5 26 36 / 0.1), 0 4px 4px rgb(5 26 36 / 0.09), inset 0 2px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0D212C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #051A24; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Halo's marketing site is a white studio page, not a landscape SaaS hero. Ink is the only chrome color. Conversion is one verb: Download Halo.
keyCharacteristics: Pill buttons with stacked ink shadows

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Buttons, type, and dark cards all use the same ink.

rules.name: The Short Accent Rule
rules.body: Bitmap type is for one or two words.

dos: Do keep the page white from first pixel to last
Do prove the product with real captures
Do mark testimonials as samples until real quotes exist
donts: Don't invent prices, Store URLs, or customer names
Don't bring back CoolDock landscape or glass headers
Don't set long sentences in the bitmap face
